sentences.en: Philosophy is not so difficult a subject as you imagine.
sentences.zh: 哲学并没有你想象中的那么难。

sentences.en: My strong point is my philosophy - nothing ventured nothing gained.
sentences.zh: 我的强项是我的理念——不尝试就等于失去了成功的机会。

sentences.en: Today I have to see my new professor of philosophy.
sentences.zh: 今天我得去见我的新哲学教授。

senses.zh: 哲学；人生哲学，处世态度；（某一学科或活动的）原理，方法；冷静，镇定
